# The AI Journal: Moving Agentic AI From Demo to Production


In a new byline for The AI Journal, Calix CPO Shane Eleniak explains why agentic AI stalls in pilots: it's not model capability, but trust. He emphasizes that true trust means asking whether a specific action is appropriate for a specific agent, right now—and outlines the guardrails, roles, and oversight needed to move agents into production.


[Read the full article on The AI Journal](https://aijourn.com/stuck-in-demo-land-how-trust-can-get-agentic-ai-into-production)
